            if browser.contexts:

            pass

        browser, _ = ensure_browser_running(playwright)
        context = browser.contexts[0]
        first = reset_tabs(context)
        navigate(first, urls[0])
        for url in urls[1:]:
            page = context.new_page()
            navigate(page, url)
        time.sleep(2)
